title: What Scripture Actually Says About Hosting People (It's Not About a Nice Place)
caption:
Most guys wait to host until they have a nicer place. A real table. Matching plates. A couch that didn't come off the curb.

Scripture never set that bar. It just kept saying: open the door. Feed people. Invite the ones who can't invite you back.

Pick one night this month. Make a pot of chili. Ask two guys, and make one of them the guy who usually eats alone. Put the phones away and ask a real question.

"When you give a feast, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind, and you will be blessed, because they cannot repay you." Luke 14:13-14

Save this. Send it to the roommate you're hosting with.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #hospitality #leadership
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
